svg.title: Figure 08 · Negative rates and discount-factor positivity
svg.desc: This hypothetical Nelson–Siegel curve has negative short rates and positive long rates. Positive discounts do not imply decreasing discounts; the admissibility of negative rates depends on the funding and cash-storage framework.
